name: Airbyte (self-hosted)
sku: Airbyte Self-Managed Community, self-hosted. Airbyte Cloud and Self-Managed Enterprise are separate, closed-source commercial editions and are not scored.

ingest.batch-extract.note: 600+ pre-built connectors, plus a no-code Connector Builder with AI assist for building your own from a source's API docs. Full refresh or incremental sync modes.

ingest.cdc.note: Log-based CDC for supported databases embeds Debezium to capture inserts, updates and deletes from the transaction log continuously, without standing up and operating Kafka yourself.

bands.note: Schema change management can require manual approval before a source's field or stream changes propagate, and automatically pauses a connection when a breaking change (a removed primary key or cursor) is detected, rather than always auto-propagating. Free on every plan tier, but is a configuration choice, not a formal schema validated on every record.
The no-code Connector Builder, with AI assist that reads a source's API documentation to auto-fill configuration, is the tooling for authoring a custom connector.
Sync health, record counts and failure notifications per connection. It covers connector health, not the data's own quality.

presentation.tagline: Open-source data movement: 600+ connectors, self-hosted, log-based CDC built in.

cost.note: No licence cost (ELv2 core is free to run yourself). This range is the small VM or container running the platform and worker pods continuously, not an Airbyte charge.
No licence cost. A properly sized instance and more worker capacity for more connections syncing on shorter schedules; generic cloud compute pricing, not an Airbyte-specific figure.
